segments.name: Banking
segments.description: Community-oriented savings bank providing personal and commercial banking, treasury management and wealth management services to customers across its branch network.
segments.evidence: Northwest Bank is a community-oriented financial institution offering personal and commercial banking solutions, investment management and trust services.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest on loans, while customers pay service charges and fees and pay for trust and other financial services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our principal source of income is interest received on loans and marketable securities.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company completed its acquisition of Penns Woods Bancorp and merged its subsidiary banks into Northwest Bank.
changes.evidence: Penns Woods' wholly-owned subsidiary banks, Luzerne Bank, a Pennsylvania-chartered state bank, and Jersey Shore State Bank, a Pennsylvania-chartered state bank, merged with and into Northwest Bank, with Northwest Bank as the surviving bank in the subsidiary bank mergers.
